manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Find whether the AST public disclosure PDF is the target confirmation form without over-trusting a yearless filename.
search_queries: 関西医科専門学校 機関要件確認申請書
関西医科専門学校 様式第2号
steps: Open the AST school public disclosure PDF under /jyouhoukokai/pdf/.
Verify the PDF body starts with 様式第２号 and the school name 関西医科専門学校.
Observe that the filename kmc_yosiki2.pdf and the direct PDF URL do not carry target-fiscal-year evidence.
Queue the PDF for operator review instead of accepting it as strict FY2026.

reusable_rules: Treat /jyouhoukokai/pdf/*_yosiki2.pdf as a strong target-form candidate when the body contains 様式第２号 and the school name.
Route target-looking PDFs without URL, anchor, or body fiscal-year evidence to operator review.
Keep the school disclosure URL as a useful parent even when the manual trace starts from the direct PDF.
anti_patterns: Do not mark a yearless yoshiki2 filename as strict target-year success.
Do not reject the file as non-target only because page one starts with the実務経験 section.

evidence.notes: Manual web trace on 2026-05-11 verified the direct PDF body contains 関西医科専門学校 and 様式第２号, but no reliable FY2026 evidence was visible in the URL or opening text.
